detailed_descriptions.en: Earn your cards. Discover what they become. In Silberheim, you build your collection by playing – card packs are never sold. But your cards don’t stay the way you found them: through your choices and experiences, they evolve and become something uniquely your own. Battle in a tactically demanding collectible card game, uncover the stories and secrets of a world that keeps evolving, and write your own story through the cards you play. Your deck can be copied—but your cards can’t! Your decisions and actions determine which cards evolve, when they evolve, and how. This creates unique cards with individual abilities that tell your story and unlock new tactical possibilities. You will have to discover for yourself when and how these evolutions occur. Our community actively shares its findings. Join the discussion and contribute your own discoveries! Card packs can’t be purchased in Silberheim—you earn them by playing. Future card expansions will be offered as optional add-ons. The base game will remain fully playable and, thanks to its evolving cards, competitively viable. Because in Silberheim, it’s play to win , not pay to win. Experience a complex yet accessible card game where matches are not over after just two minutes. Command your cards across three rows and develop sophisticated tactics. In addition to the primary resource, Combat Morale, make use of a wide variety of secondary resources and adapt your decks to your personal playstyle. Discover the rich lore and fantasy world of Silberheim. Explore the lore text of every card and admire handcrafted artwork created by artists and grounded in carefully developed worldbuilding. A steady stream of free PvE content and events will help you discover more of Silberheim. Silberheim grows with you. New cards, mechanics, events, and combinations continuously expand your tactical options without diminishing the value of your existing collection. This creates an ever-growing range of strategies, challenges, and paths for progression, ensuring lasting enjoyment. Immerse yourself in the lore of Silberheim and explore an expansive new fantasy world. Begin your journey in the unfathomable Soul Chamber. Armed with vague memories of past lives—your playing cards—you have only one goal: to live. But to earn your rebirth on the planet Midoa, you must prove yourself and not merely face challenges, but master them. Discover more on our Silberheim website , including… Daemonion, the first novel in the “Silberheim Memories” series numerous free spin-offs featuring even more Silberheim lore exciting website articles with background information about the game, its artwork, the team, and more a detailed world map that lets you explore Midoa’s first region The Beyond Worlds team hopes you have a great time in Silberheim and looks forward to shaping this exciting world together with you in the future.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Earn your cards. Discover what they become.

In Silberheim, you build your collection by playing – card packs are never sold. But your cards don’t stay the way you found them: through your choices and experiences, they evolve and become something uniquely your own.

Battle in a tactically demanding collectible card game, uncover the stories and secrets of a world that keeps evolving, and write your own story through the cards you play.

Your deck can be copied—but your cards can’t! Your decisions and actions determine which cards evolve, when they evolve, and how. This creates unique cards with individual abilities that tell your story and unlock new tactical possibilities. You will have to discover for yourself when and how these evolutions occur. Our community actively shares its findings. Join the discussion and contribute your own discoveries!

Card packs can’t be purchased in Silberheim—you earn them by playing. Future card expansions will be offered as optional add-ons. The base game will remain fully playable and, thanks to its evolving cards, competitively viable. Because in Silberheim, it’s play to win, not pay to win.

Experience a complex yet accessible card game where matches are not over after just two minutes. Command your cards across three rows and develop sophisticated tactics. In addition to the primary resource, Combat Morale, make use of a wide variety of secondary resources and adapt your decks to your personal playstyle.

Discover the rich lore and fantasy world of Silberheim. Explore the lore text of every card and admire handcrafted artwork created by artists and grounded in carefully developed worldbuilding. A steady stream of free PvE content and events will help you discover more of Silberheim.

Silberheim grows with you. New cards, mechanics, events, and combinations continuously expand your tactical options without diminishing the value of your existing collection. This creates an ever-growing range of strategies, challenges, and paths for progression, ensuring lasting enjoyment.

Immerse yourself in the lore of Silberheim and explore an expansive new fantasy world. Begin your journey in the unfathomable Soul Chamber. Armed with vague memories of past lives—your playing cards—you have only one goal: to live. But to earn your rebirth on the planet Midoa, you must prove yourself and not merely face challenges, but master them.

Discover more on our Silberheim website, including…

  • Daemonion, the first novel in the “Silberheim Memories” series

  • numerous free spin-offs featuring even more Silberheim lore

  • exciting website articles with background information about the game, its artwork, the team, and more

  • a detailed world map that lets you explore Midoa’s first region

The Beyond Worlds team hopes you have a great time in Silberheim and looks forward to shaping this exciting world together with you in the future.
